spine.zh: 黄仁勋复职与油价新低

marketTone.en: US stocks had their largest rise in more than a year and a half after Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia's chief executive. January crude settled at a three-month low.
marketTone.zh: 黄仁勋回归英伟达之后，美股创下一年半多来最大涨幅。1月原油结算在三个月低点。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn breakfast (24 November). Monday closes, the Taiwan margin drop, Germany's PMI flash, and bitcoin at 61258 dollars.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻早餐（11月24日）。周一收盘、台湾融资余额下降、德国PMI初值，以及比特币61258美元。

keySources.label: 华尔街见闻 11月24日英伟达

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (24 November). Nvidia rose 31.48%, and its market value increased by 952 billion dollars in one day.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月24日）。英伟达上涨31.48%，市值单日增加9520亿美元。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (24 November). January WTI at 80.17 dollars and January Brent at 89.37 dollars, both a three-month low.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月24日）。1月WTI 80.17美元，1月布伦特89.37美元，均为三个月低点。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (24 November). The US composite PMI flash is 54.6, a four-month low.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月24日）。美国综合PMI初值54.6，为四个月低点。

keySources.label: 华尔街见闻 11月24日威廉姆斯

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (24 November). Williams said inflation is still short of 2%, and he left open increases at a string of meetings.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月24日）。威廉姆斯说通胀仍未到2%，并留下了一连串会议加息的可能。

influence.en: Wallstreetcn (24 November). Congo halts all cobalt exports from 30 November, with no end date set.
influence.zh: 华尔街见闻（11月24日）。刚果（金）从11月30日起暂停全部钴出口，结束日期未定。

influence.en: Yicai (24 November). Nvidia closed at 165.05 dollars, up 31.48%.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月24日）。英伟达收于165.05美元，上涨31.48%。

influence.en: Yicai (24 November). Huang is due at a Senate Banking hearing on 3 December on export-control oversight.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月24日）。黄仁勋将于12月3日出席参议院银行委员会出口管制监督听证会。

influence.en: Caixin (23 November). The board voted to restore Huang, the independent probe continues, and Nvidia will add a chief compliance officer.
influence.zh: 财新（11月23日）。董事会投票恢复黄仁勋职务，独立调查继续，英伟达将增设首席合规官。

influence.en: US Treasury curve for 23 November. The 2-year yield is 4.63%, the 10-year is 4.92%, and the 30-year is 5.29%. On 20 November the 30-year was 5.31%.
CNBC live blog. Monday closes for the Dow, the S&P 500, and the Nasdaq.
influence.zh: CNBC直播博客。周一的道指、标普500和纳斯达克收盘。

influence.en: CICC (15 November). The dollar's rise came from officials' hawkish turn.
influence.zh: 中金（11月15日）。美元走强来自官员的鹰派转向。

influence.en: Glassnode (17 November). Realized losses reached a level seen only near past cycle lows.
influence.zh: Glassnode（11月17日）。已实现亏损达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。

influence.en: 24 November 财经早茶. Huang's return, the Megaspeed blacklist, oil, and the Taiwan margin chart.
influence.zh: 11月24日财经早茶。黄仁勋回归、Megaspeed黑名单、原油，以及台湾融资这张图。

title.en: Taiwan margin balances show the largest daily drop in thirty years
title.zh: 台湾融资余额出现三十年来最大单日下降

analysis.en: The latest bar is the deepest drop on the chart. A published reading of that day is a fall of about 49 billion Taiwan dollars. Leveraged buying was cut at a record pace.
analysis.zh: 最新一根是图上最深的下降。见闻称当天融资余额减少约490亿元新台币。杠杆买盘被以创纪录的速度砍掉。

text.en: US stocks had their largest rise in more than a year and a half. The Dow rose 3.01% to 49595.31, the S&P 500 rose 4.73% to 7237.17, and the Nasdaq rose 6.51% to 24089.56, 华尔街见闻 reported. Nvidia rose 31.48% to 165.05 dollars, 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 美股创下一年半多来最大涨幅。华尔街见闻：道指上涨3.01%至49595.31，标普500上涨4.73%至7237.17，纳斯达克上涨6.51%至24089.56。第一财经：英伟达上涨31.48%至165.05美元。

text.en: January WTI fell 3.88% to 80.17 dollars a barrel, and January Brent fell 3.46% to 89.37 dollars, both a three-month low, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：1月WTI下跌3.88%至每桶80.17美元，1月布伦特下跌3.46%至89.37美元，均为三个月低点。

text.en: COMEX December gold rose 4.2% to 3663 dollars an ounce, 华尔街见闻 reported. The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.63%, the 10-year is 4.92%, and the 30-year is 5.29%.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 12月黄金上涨4.2%至每盎司3663美元。美国财政部：2年期收益率4.63%，10年期4.92%，30年期5.29%。

text.en: The Shanghai Composite rose 0.15% to 3538.95, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.93% to 10454.37, and the ChiNext rose 3.08% to 2280.20, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Kospi fell 3.32% to 4708.54, and Tokyo was closed.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：上证指数上涨0.15%至3538.95，深证成指上涨1.93%至10454.37，创业板指上涨3.08%至2280.20。韩国综指下跌3.32%至4708.54，东京休市。

signal.en: Huang's return repriced US stocks in one session, while January crude settled at a three-month low.
signal.zh: 黄仁勋的回归在一个交易日里重定价了美股，1月原油结算在三个月低点。

watch.en: Germany's Ifo survey is at 17:00 Beijing. US consumer confidence is at 23:00. October PCE is on Wednesday. The margin-floor cut takes effect on 30 November. Huang testifies on 3 December.
watch.zh: 德国Ifo调查在北京时间17:00。美国消费者信心指数在23:00。10月PCE在周三。融资保证金下限调整在11月30日生效。黄仁勋在12月3日作证。

title.en: Huang's return gave US stocks their largest rise in a year and a half
title.zh: 黄仁勋回归，美股创一年半来最大涨幅

fact.en: The Dow rose 3.01% to 49595.31, the S&P 500 rose 4.73% to 7237.17, and the Nasdaq rose 6.51% to 24089.56, 华尔街见闻 reported. Nvidia rose 31.48% to 165.05 dollars, the largest one-day rise since 2003, and its market value increased by 952 billion dollars, 华尔街见闻 and 第一财经 reported. The Philadelphia semiconductor index rose 14.03%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：道指上涨3.01%至49595.31，标普500上涨4.73%至7237.17，纳斯达克上涨6.51%至24089.56。华尔街见闻、第一财经：英伟达上涨31.48%至165.05美元，为2003年以来最大单日涨幅，市值增加9520亿美元。华尔街见闻：费城半导体指数上涨14.03%。

factSources.label: 华尔街见闻 11月24日英伟达

mechanism.en: Nvidia rose 31.48%, and that one session turned a seven-day drop into the largest US stock rise in more than a year and a half. Morgan Stanley (23 November): last week's drop is a buying opportunity, and the team wants investors to add risk. US stocks and Nvidia shares are the markets that rose.
mechanism.zh: 英伟达上涨31.48%，这一个交易日把连续七日的下跌变成了一年半多来最大的美股涨幅。摩根士丹利（11月23日）：上周的下跌是买入机会，该团队希望投资者增加风险。上涨的是美股和英伟达。

title.en: Treasury yields barely moved as the activity survey cooled
title.zh: 活动调查降温，国债收益率几乎没动

fact.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.63%, the 10-year is 4.92%, and the 30-year is 5.29%. On 20 November the 30-year was 5.31%, and the 2-year and 10-year were unchanged. The composite PMI flash fell to 54.6, a four-month low, and Williams said inflation is still short of 2%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 美国财政部：2年期收益率4.63%，10年期4.92%，30年期5.29%。11月20日30年期为5.31%，2年期和10年期没有变化。华尔街见闻：综合PMI初值降至54.6，为四个月低点，威廉姆斯说通胀仍未到2%。

factSources.label: 华尔街见闻 11月24日威廉姆斯

mechanism.en: The 2-year yield stayed at 4.63% and the 10-year stayed at 4.92%, so the slower survey did not move those two yields. Williams (23 November): inflation is still short of 2%, and he left open increases at a string of meetings. The 30-year is the maturity that eased, to 5.29%.
mechanism.zh: 2年期收益率停在4.63%，10年期停在4.92%，所以更慢的调查没有带动这两个收益率。威廉姆斯（11月23日）：通胀仍未到2%，他留下了一连串会议加息的可能。回落的是30年期，到5.29%。

title.en: December gold rose 4.2% and ended a five-day drop

fact.en: COMEX December gold rose 4.2% to 3663 dollars an ounce, 华尔街见闻 reported. 财经早茶 reported that gold ended a five-day drop.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：COMEX 12月黄金上涨4.2%至每盎司3663美元。财经早茶：黄金结束了五连跌。

mechanism.en: Gold rose on a day when crude fell, so the two markets moved apart. 财经早茶 (24 November): gold ended a five-day drop as appetite for risk returned. Gold is the market that rose.
mechanism.zh: 原油下跌的这一天黄金上涨了，两个市场走了不同的方向。财经早茶（11月24日）：风险偏好回来之后，黄金结束了五连跌。上涨的是黄金。

title.en: January crude settled at a three-month low

fact.en: January WTI fell 3.88% to 80.17 dollars a barrel, and January Brent fell 3.46% to 89.37 dollars, both the lowest settle in three months, 华尔街见闻 reported. A Libya pipeline restarted, and Middle East supply rose, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：1月WTI下跌3.88%至每桶80.17美元，1月布伦特下跌3.46%至89.37美元，均为三个月来最低结算价。利比亚一条输油管道恢复运营，中东供应增加。

mechanism.en: Both January contracts settled at a three-month low after a Libya pipeline restarted. JPM (23 November): a supply surplus can pull Brent back toward the high 70s in the first half of 2027. Crude is the market that fell.
mechanism.zh: 利比亚管道恢复之后，两个1月合约都结算在三个月低点。摩根大通（11月23日）：供应过剩可能把布伦特在2027年上半年拉回70美元高位一带。下跌的是原油。

title.en: London copper closed higher after trading under 12000

fact.en: LME three-month copper rose 330 dollars to 12490 dollars a tonne after trading under 12000, 华尔街见闻 reported. Shanghai copper's night session rose 2.77%, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：LME三个月期铜上涨330美元至每吨12490美元，盘中一度跌破12000美元。沪铜夜盘上涨2.77%。

mechanism.en: London copper closed at 12490 dollars after the session traded under 12000, so the low was deeper than the close. 财经早茶 (24 November): industrial metals rose with the return of risk appetite. Copper is the market that recovered into the close.
mechanism.zh: 伦铜收在12490美元，盘中曾跌到12000美元下方，所以低点比收盘更深。财经早茶（11月24日）：工业金属随着风险偏好回归而上涨。收盘收回来的是铜。

title.en: European stocks had their biggest rise in more than two weeks
title.zh: 欧洲股市创两周多来最大涨幅

fact.en: The STOXX 600 rose 1.81% to 636.97, and the euro-area STOXX 50 rose 2.23% to 6074.47, 华尔街见闻 reported. Germany's composite PMI flash rose to 55.0 from 53.4, above the 53.2 forecast, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：STOXX 600上涨1.81%至636.97，欧元区STOXX 50上涨2.23%至6074.47。德国综合PMI初值从53.4升至55.0，高于53.2的预期。

mechanism.en: European stocks had their biggest rise in more than two weeks, and German bond yields fell with oil. 财经早茶 (24 November): German yields followed oil lower, and ASML jumped. European stocks and German bonds are the markets that moved.
mechanism.zh: 欧洲股市创下两周多来最大涨幅，德国国债收益率随油价下降。财经早茶（11月24日）：德国收益率跟着油价走低，阿斯麦大涨。跟着动的是欧洲股市和德国国债。

title.en: The dollar index rose through 104, and the yuan still firmed
title.zh: 美元指数升破104，人民币仍然走强

fact.en: The ICE dollar index rose 0.49% to 104.320, through 104 for the first time since April 2025, 华尔街见闻 reported. Offshore yuan was 6.6665 per dollar, and onshore yuan finished the night session at 6.6667, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：ICE美元指数上涨0.49%至104.320，为2025年4月以来首次升破104。离岸人民币报6.6665，在岸人民币夜盘收于6.6667。

mechanism.en: The dollar index rose through 104, and the yuan still firmed on the night session. CICC (15 November): the dollar's rise came from officials' hawkish turn. The dollar and the yuan both moved.
mechanism.zh: 美元指数升破104，人民币在夜盘仍然走强。中金（11月15日）：美元走强来自官员的鹰派转向。美元和人民币都动了。

title.en: Megaspeed was blacklisted, and Hong Kong tech barely fell
title.zh: Megaspeed被列入黑名单，港股科技几乎没跌

fact.en: The Hang Seng fell 0.12% to 22383.74, and the Hang Seng Tech index fell 0.09% to 3508.00, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Commerce Department put Megaspeed on the trade blacklist and barred it from buying advanced AI chips, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：恒生指数下跌0.12%至22383.74，恒生科技指数下跌0.09%至3508.00。财经早茶：美国商务部将Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单，禁止其购买先进人工智能芯片。

mechanism.en: The blacklist turns the export-control review into a purchase ban for that firm. 财经早茶 (24 November): Huang will testify in the Senate on how those controls are enforced. Hong Kong tech shares barely fell.
mechanism.zh: 这份黑名单把出口管制审查变成了对这家公司的采购禁令。财经早茶（11月24日）：黄仁勋将在参议院说明这些管制如何执行。港股科技几乎没跌。

title.en: Brokers can flex margin calls, and ChiNext led A-shares higher
title.zh: 券商可灵活追保，创业板领涨A股

fact.en: Regulators told brokers they may adjust maintenance margins and the timing of forced sales during a volatile market, and must avoid clustered selling at the open and the close, 华尔街见闻 reported. The Shanghai Composite rose 0.15% to 3538.95, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.93% to 10454.37, and the ChiNext rose 3.08% to 2280.20, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：监管部门要求券商在市场波动期间可以调整维持担保比例和平仓时间，并避免在早盘和尾市集中卖出。上证指数上涨0.15%至3538.95，深证成指上涨1.93%至10454.37，创业板指上涨3.08%至2280.20。

mechanism.en: Brokers can now flex maintenance margins during a selloff, so forced selling does not have to cluster at the open and the close. 财经早茶 (23 November): the exchanges are cutting the financed-buying floor after Chinese stocks stayed under pressure. A-shares are the market that rose, led by ChiNext.
mechanism.zh: 券商现在可以在下跌时调整维持担保比例，所以强平不必挤在早盘和尾市。财经早茶（11月23日）：中国股市持续承压之后，交易所正在下调融资买入的保证金下限。上涨的是A股，创业板领涨。

title.en: Bitcoin's day change was small after Friday's drop
title.zh: 周五大跌之后，比特币日内变动很小

fact.en: Bitcoin stood at 61258 dollars, up about 0.2% over 24 hours, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：比特币报61258美元，24小时上涨约0.2%。

mechanism.en: The day's change was about 0.2%, so Monday did not extend Friday's swing. Glassnode (17 November): realized losses had reached a level seen only near past cycle lows. Bitcoin is the market that steadied.
mechanism.zh: 当天的变动大约是0.2%，所以周一没有把周五的波动再拉开。Glassnode（11月17日）：已实现亏损已经达到过去只在周期低点附近出现过的水平。稳住的是比特币。

title.en: Taiwan's margin balance had its largest daily drop in thirty years
title.zh: 台湾融资余额创三十年最大单日降幅

fact.en: Taiwan's stock margin balance fell by 49 billion Taiwan dollars on Friday, the largest one-day drop since 1996, 华尔街见闻 reported. The weighted index fell 17.5% last week and rose 2.16% on Monday, and Goldman cut Taiwan to neutral, 华尔街见闻 reported.
fact.zh: 华尔街见闻：上周五台湾股市融资余额减少490亿元新台币，为1996年以来最大单日降幅。加权指数上周下跌17.5%，周一上涨2.16%，高盛把台湾评级下调至中性。

mechanism.en: Friday's drop in the margin balance is the largest daily drop in that record, so leveraged buying was cut at a record pace. Goldman (24 November): the house cut Taiwan to neutral as maintenance ratios sat near the margin-call line. Taiwan equities are the market this unwind hit.
mechanism.zh: 周五融资余额的下降是该统计以来最大的单日降幅，所以杠杆买盘被以创纪录的速度砍掉。高盛（11月24日）：维持担保比例靠近追缴线，该行把台湾下调至中性。这次去杠杆打到的是台股。

text.en: The S&P 500 rebounded after seven down days, its largest rise in more than a year and a half, as Huang's return lit up technology shares.
text.zh: 标普500指数在七连跌后强劲反弹，创下一年半多来最大涨幅，黄仁勋回归点燃科技股涨势。

text.en: The Golden Dragon index ended a five-day drop. Alibaba and Baidu contributed the most.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数止步五连跌，阿里巴巴和百度对指数贡献最大。

text.en: Long-term Treasury yields fell with oil. The 2-year auction yield came in below the when-issued level, so demand was a bit stronger than expected.
text.zh: 长期美债收益率跟随油价走低。2年期美债发行中标收益率低于发行前交易水平，显示需求略超预期。

text.en: The Bloomberg dollar index rose. The euro lagged and reached its lowest level in more than a year and a half.
text.zh: 彭博美元指数上涨，欧元表现落后，创下一年半多来最低水平。

text.en: German bond yields fell with oil. European stocks had their largest rise in more than two weeks, and ASML jumped.
text.zh: 德债收益率跟随油价下跌。欧洲股市创两周多来最大涨幅，阿斯麦飙升。

text.en: Crude futures fell hard. Trump signaled more time for diplomacy with Iran, and the market is also looking at a supply surplus.
text.zh: 原油期货重挫。特朗普暗示将为伊朗外交斡旋留出更多时间，同时市场预期石油供应过剩。

text.en: London industrial metals rose as Huang's return lifted appetite for risk. Gold ended a five-day drop.
text.zh: 伦敦工业金属普涨，黄仁勋回归提振风险偏好。黄金止步五连跌。

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

globalRegime.en: US stocks reversed a seven-day drop after Huang returned as Nvidia's chief executive. January crude settled at a three-month low. Treasury yields barely moved, and the dollar index rose through 104.
globalRegime.zh: 黄仁勋回归担任英伟达首席执行官之后，美股扭转了连续七日的下跌。1月原油结算在三个月低点。国债收益率几乎没动，美元指数升破104。

text.en: Less than two weeks after he resigned, Nvidia's board called Huang back, with the US president involved. Trump called him a national treasure and said there is no evidence of illegal conduct, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：黄仁勋离职不到两周，英伟达董事会在美国总统介入后把他召回。特朗普称他是国家瑰宝，并说没有证据表明他存在违法行为。

text.en: Senate Democratic leader Schumer said Democrats will use every power they have to investigate whether Huang, other Nvidia executives, and the administration put economic interests ahead of national security, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：参议院民主党领袖舒默表示，民主党将动用全部权力，调查黄仁勋、英伟达其他高管和特朗普政府是否为了经济利益损害国家安全。

text.en: Huang is due to testify in public at the Senate Banking Committee on 3 December, with the hearing focused on export-control enforcement. The Commerce Department put Megaspeed on the trade blacklist, 财经早茶 and 第一财经 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、第一财经：黄仁勋将于12月3日在参议院银行委员会公开作证，听证会重点是出口管制的执行。美国商务部已将Megaspeed列入贸易黑名单。

text.en: The board voted to restore Huang as president, chief executive, and director. The independent probe continues, and Nvidia will add a chief compliance officer, 财新 reported.
text.zh: 财新：董事会投票恢复黄仁勋的总裁、首席执行官和董事职务。独立调查继续，英伟达将增设首席合规官。

text.en: Morgan Stanley called the drop in US stocks a buying opportunity that is too good to miss. Wells Fargo raised US large caps to its most favored rating and said last week's drop was a chance to add, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：摩根士丹利认为美股的下跌是不容错过的买入机会。富国把美国大盘股上调至最看好评级，称上周的暴跌提供了加仓机会。

text.en: New York Fed president Williams said the Fed has to act over time so inflation gets back to 2% and stays there, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：纽约联储行长威廉姆斯表示，美联储需要逐步采取行动，把通胀及时、持续地拉回2%。

text.en: The S&P Global US composite PMI flash showed business activity at its slowest pace in four months, with high prices, transport delays, and capacity limits weighing on firms, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：标普全球美国综合PMI初值显示，企业活动扩张放缓至四个月来最慢，高价格、运输延误和产能限制令企业承压。

text.en: Amazon has agreed to buy most of the assets of AI startup Decart, to strengthen its own infrastructure and push its Trainium chips, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：亚马逊同意收购人工智能初创公司Decart的大部分资产，以加强自己的基础设施并推动Trainium芯片。

text.en: Western intelligence agencies warned that Russia has built a satellite that can carry a nuclear warhead and could launch it as soon as next month, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：西方情报机构警告，俄罗斯已制造出可搭载核弹头的卫星，最早可能下月发射。

text.en: Congo, the largest cobalt producer, will halt all cobalt exports again from 30 November, with no end date set, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：全球最大钴生产国刚果（金）将从11月30日起再次暂停全部钴出口，结束日期未定。

text.en: CrowdStrike is buying Zscaler in an all-stock deal. Each Zscaler share is to be exchanged for 1.135 CrowdStrike shares, a 34% premium to Friday's close of 194.82 dollars, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：CrowdStrike以全股票方式收购Zscaler。每股Zscaler股票将换成1.135股CrowdStrike股票，较周五收盘价194.82美元溢价34%。

text.en: If the 3 December hearing produces a tighter export rule, the one-day chip rebound can fade even with Huang back in the job.
text.zh: 若12月3日的听证会引出更紧的出口规则，芯片股这一日的反弹可能消退，即便黄仁勋已经回到职位上。

text.en: If the Libya pipeline stays open and the late-November supply meeting does not cut output, January crude can stay near this three-month low.
text.zh: 若利比亚管道保持开通，且11月底的供应会议不减产，1月原油可能停在这个三个月低点附近。

text.en: If Wednesday's PCE price index stays hot, Williams's case for a string of increases stays intact even though Monday's yields barely moved.
text.zh: 若周三的PCE物价指数仍然偏热，威廉姆斯关于一连串加息的说法就还在，尽管周一的收益率几乎没动。

globalTensions.en: US stocks and gold rose while crude and the Kospi fell. The dollar index rose through 104, and the yuan firmed anyway. The activity survey cooled, and Treasury yields barely moved.
globalTensions.zh: 美股和黄金上涨，原油和韩国综指下跌。美元指数升破104，人民币却走强。活动调查降温了，国债收益率几乎没动。

chinaStance.en: Regulators told brokers to flex maintenance margins during volatile sessions, on top of a financed-buying floor that is due to fall later this month. Taiwan is studying a larger stabilization fund after a record one-day drop in margin balances. The monetary authority of Singapore said it will work with the PBOC on a yuan facility backed by their swap line.
chinaStance.zh: 监管部门要求券商在波动行情里灵活调整维持担保比例，这叠在本月晚些时候将下调的融资买入保证金下限之上。台湾在融资余额创下单日最大降幅之后，正在研究扩大稳定基金。新加坡金融管理局表示，将与中国央行合作完善互换支持的人民币便利。

text.en: Trump said he expects China to buy Boeing jets and previewed a soybean purchase. Whether either order is set remains unclear, and he did not name the soybean buyer, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：特朗普预计中国将购买波音飞机，并预告一项大豆采购协议。两笔订单是否已经敲定仍不清楚，他也没有说出大豆的买家。

text.en: Taiwan said its national security fund bought shares to steady the market and is studying a larger fund. The premier met executives from technology and finance, including TSMC, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：台湾称国安基金进场稳定股市，并在研究把基金做大。行政院长与包括台积电在内的科技和金融业高管开会。

text.en: Taiwan holds local elections on 28 November. The vote is a test of the ruling party's support and can reshape cross-strait politics, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：台湾将于11月28日举行地方选举。选举结果将检验执政党的支持度，也可能重塑两岸关系。

text.en: Vice finance minister Liao Min, at the China-EU financial dialogue, called on the EU to give Chinese firms a fair and non-discriminatory environment, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：财政部副部长廖岷在中欧财金对话中呼吁欧盟为中国企业提供公平、非歧视的环境。

text.en: The Monetary Authority of Singapore said it will work with the PBOC to improve a yuan facility backed by their bilateral swap, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：新加坡金融管理局表示，将与中国央行合作完善双边本币互换支持的人民币便利。

text.en: Embodied-intelligence startup Zhijian Power raised a round led by Ant Group, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：具身智能初创公司至简动力完成一轮融资，由蚂蚁集团领投。

text.en: Regulators told brokers to flex maintenance margins and the timing of forced sales, and to avoid clustered selling at the open and the close, 华尔街见闻 reported.
text.zh: 华尔街见闻：监管部门要求券商灵活调整维持担保比例和平仓时间，避免早盘和尾市集中卖出。

text.en: If brokers use the new discretion, forced sales at the open and the close can be smaller in the next volatile session.
text.zh: 若券商用上新的裁量空间，下一轮波动行情里，早盘和尾市的强平可以更少。

text.en: The lower financed-buying floor is still not in force. It takes effect on 30 November, so Monday's A-share rise did not come from that rule.
text.zh: 更低的融资买入保证金下限还没有生效。它在11月30日实施，所以周一A股的上涨不是这条规则带来的。

chinaDivergences.en: A-shares rose, led by ChiNext, while Hong Kong was almost flat and the Kospi fell. The yuan firmed even as the dollar index rose through 104. Taiwan's margin balance had a record one-day drop, and officials there are still only studying a larger stabilization fund.
chinaDivergences.zh: A股上涨，创业板领涨，港股几乎走平，韩国综指下跌。美元指数升破104，人民币却走强。台湾融资余额创下单日最大降幅，当地官员仍只是在研究扩大稳定基金。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 24 November, through next Friday, 4 December. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy decision falls in these dates. The next decision is scheduled for 9 December. After the November switch to standard time, a decision at 14:00 US Eastern is 03:00 Beijing the next day.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月24日到下周五12月4日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息决定。下一次决定排在12月9日。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。
